## 📝 Description

#### Describe what this PR does. If it changes behavior, explain:
- What was the previous behavior?
- What is the new behavior?
- Why was this change needed?
---

## 🧩 Type of Change
Select **one or more** that apply by marking `[x]`:

- [ ] ✨ Feature — New functionality without breaking existing features
- [ ] 🛠️ Bug Fix — Fixes an issue without altering current behavior
- [ ] 🧹 Refactor — Code improvements without behavior change
- [ ] ❌ Breaking Change — Modifies existing functionality
- [ ] 🧪 Tests — Added or updated tests
- [ ] 📝 Documentation — Updated or added documentation
- [ ] 🗑️ Chore — Maintenance or minor updates
- [ ] ✅ Build/Config — Build or configuration updates

---

## ✅ Checklist
Please confirm the following before submitting:

- [ ] I have tested these changes locally
- [ ] I have incremented the **package version** as appropriate
- [ ] I have updated **CHANGELOG.md** with my changes
- [ ] I have added or updated relevant **documentation**
- [ ] I have run **“Organize Imports”** on all changed files
- [ ] I have resolved all **analyzer warnings** as best I could
- [ ] The code follows the project’s **style and conventions**

## 🧠 Additional Notes (Optional)
Add any extra context, screenshots, or notes that help reviewers understand your changes.
